description: Fix Ralph executor auto-skip branch that marks timed-out tasks as passed and never increments failed counter

tasks.title: Fix auto-skip branch logic in ralph-executor.ts
tasks.description: Fix the auto-skip branch (line 589-592): change `passes: true` to `passes: false`, add `failed++` and `skipped++` after the branch. Add `skipped` variable initialized to 0 at the top of `runRalphLoop`. Update `RalphLoopResult` interface to include `skipped: number`. Update the final result object and early-return result objects to include `skipped`.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-skip branch sets passes: false (not true) in updateTaskInList
Auto-skip branch increments failed++ and skipped++
RalphLoopResult interface has skipped: number field
Final result object includes skipped counter and success: failed === 0
tasks.notes: Key lines to change: 589-592 (auto-skip branch), 119-128 (RalphLoopResult type), 288-294 and 576-587 and 607-613 (result objects).

tasks.title: Add unit tests for auto-skip failure handling
tasks.description: Write unit tests that verify: (1) a non-retryable failure without onAskUser sets passes=false, increments failed and skipped, and returns success=false; (2) a retryable failure with retries exhausted behaves the same; (3) the skipped counter is 0 when all tasks pass. Mock the task executor to simulate failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: non-retryable failure (timeout) without onAskUser → passes=false, failed=1, skipped=1, success=false
Test: max retries exceeded without onAskUser → passes=false, failed=1, skipped=1, success=false
Test: all tasks pass → failed=0, skipped=0, success=true
Test: task fails but onAskUser is provided → onAskUser is called (no auto-skip)
tasks.notes: Look at existing test files in packages/cli/tests/ for test framework and patterns used.
